items.name: United States federal government
items.description: Federal government collectively; no assertion of unitary operational command.

items.name: States
items.description: States as constitutional members of the Union, including distinct state-government actors.

items.name: State governments
items.description: Constitutionally separate state governments; not federal agencies.

items.name: State legislatures
items.description: Legislative bodies exercising state constitutional functions.

items.name: State judges
items.description: State judicial officers bound by applicable constitutional and supreme federal law.

items.name: State executives
items.description: State executive authorities when constitutional provisions assign a role.

items.name: Persons
items.description: Persons subject to relevant constitutional protections; not synonymous with citizens.

items.name: The people
items.description: The people as protected rights-holders and sovereign public; scope is provision-specific.

items.name: United States citizens
items.description: Citizenship-based rights and eligibility, distinct from rights of all persons.

items.name: Voters
items.description: Eligible voters, subject to qualifications and constitutional restrictions.

items.name: Presidential electors
items.description: Electors appointed according to constitutional and valid federal/state law.

items.name: Persons accused of crime
items.description: Rights-holders in criminal prosecutions, with scope governed by the provision and law.

items.name: Civil litigants
items.description: Parties to civil actions within applicable constitutional scope.

items.name: Federal officers
items.description: Officers of the United States, subject to applicable office and oath requirements.

items.name: State officers
items.description: State executive, legislative and judicial officeholders.

items.name: Federal courts
items.description: Article III and other federal courts as applicable; not a claim of identical constitutional tenure.

items.name: District of Columbia
items.description: Federal district, not a State; specific electors under the Twenty-Third Amendment.

items.name: Militia
items.description: Historical constitutional militia concept; not presumed identical to every current military institution.

items.name: Armed forces
items.description: Land and naval forces within the constitutional text; modern organization requires statutes.

items.name: Office candidates and officeholders
items.description: Individuals subject to eligibility, disqualification, or term-limit provisions.
